subject.title: fix(agents): agent-created files get lowercased names on Windows

question: Should OpenClaw rely on path.win32.relative for case-insensitive Windows root matching while preserving the returned path’s casing, with the added tests as the containment contract?
rationale: The implementation looks correct and fixes a demonstrated regression, but the affected helper decides whether agent-controlled paths remain inside workspace and sandbox roots, so repository policy requires explicit owner judgment rather than an automated merge decision.

options.title: Approve the containment equivalence
options.body: Confirm that prefix stripping plus path.win32.relative preserves existing accept/reject decisions, then land after rebase and exact-head checks complete.

options.title: Require separate check and output paths
options.body: Ask for an explicit normalized comparison-relative value plus a case-preserving return-relative value if maintainers do not want the security decision to rely on one path.win32.relative calculation.

recommendation.title: Approve the containment equivalence
recommendation.body: Confirm that prefix stripping plus path.win32.relative preserves existing accept/reject decisions, then land after rebase and exact-head checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman revised and merged the earlier Windows boundary implementation and previously requested the focused edge-case coverage now supplied.
